description: Defines data structures, enums, and an interface class for F1AP-DU positioning services in a 3GPP-compliant 5G network implementation.

classes.name: ocudu::odu::f1ap_du_positioning_handler
classes.description: Interface class for F1AP-DU positioning services, providing methods to request TRP info, positioning info, and measurements.

methods.name: request_trp_info
methods.description: Requests supported TRP information as per TS 38.473, Section 8.13.8.

methods.name: request_positioning_info
methods.description: Asynchronously requests UE positioning information as per TS 38.473, Section 8.13.9.

methods.name: request_positioning_measurement
methods.description: Asynchronously requests UE positioning measurement as per TS 38.473, Section 8.13.2.
